subject: WL
title: Spanish III
description: Spanish III moves students from Novice High toward Intermediate Mid proficiency through themed units on identity, childhood memories, travel, health, the environment, art and literature, community and work, technology, and celebrations across the Spanish-speaking world. Grammar focuses on preterite vs. imperfect, commands, the future and conditional, perfect tenses, and the present and imperfect subjunctive. Each week balances interpretive reading/listening with authentic sources, interpersonal conversation, presentational speaking and writing, and cultural comparison.
framework: 2019 California World Languages Standards; ACTFL Proficiency Guidelines (target: Intermediate Low–Intermediate Mid)

standards.WL-COMM1-IL: Interpretive communication (Intermediate Low): understand main ideas and some details in simple authentic texts and audio on familiar topics.
standards.WL-COMM1-IM: Interpretive communication (Intermediate Mid): understand main ideas and supporting details in a variety of authentic texts on familiar and some unfamiliar topics.
standards.WL-COMM2-IL: Interpersonal communication (Intermediate Low): ask and answer questions and maintain simple conversations on familiar topics using sentences.
standards.WL-COMM2-IM: Interpersonal communication (Intermediate Mid): sustain conversations, handle uncomplicated situations, and exchange information using strings of sentences.
standards.WL-COMM3-IL: Presentational communication (Intermediate Low): present information on familiar topics using connected sentences.
standards.WL-COMM3-IM: Presentational communication (Intermediate Mid): present and write connected paragraphs on familiar and researched topics in various time frames.
standards.WL-CULT1-IL: Cultures: use the language to investigate, explain, and reflect on the relationship between cultural practices and perspectives.
standards.WL-CULT2-IL: Cultures: use the language to investigate, explain, and reflect on the relationship between cultural products and perspectives.
standards.WL-CULT3-IL: Cultures: interact with cultural competence and understanding in authentic or simulated situations.
standards.WL-STRUC1-IL: Structures: use knowledge of the language's sound, writing, and grammar systems (including verb tenses and moods) to comprehend and communicate.
standards.WL-STRUC2-IL: Structures: compare the language's structures and cultural features with those of English.
standards.WL-CONN1-IL: Connections: build, reinforce, and expand knowledge of other disciplines through the language.
